description:
Domain-to-style mapping lookup table for the design-director diagnostic interview (§4.1). When a product domain is detected or stated, the interview logic consults this file to shortlist 2–3 foundation-style candidates before presenting them to the user.
THIS IS A LOOKUP TABLE — not a list of new foundation styles. These domain names do NOT appear in the foundation taxonomy (§3 of PRD.md). Adding them here keeps the Visual Signature axis and the Ideal Domain axis cleanly separated. The style_signatures appendix at the end carries compact per-style font/hex/radius so recommendations can render swatches without loading any style pack.

usage_notes: 2. recommend_styles() checks this file for 2–3 candidate style IDs.
3. Those candidates are presented with honest tradeoffs from the main engine.
4. The user can override at any time ("more like Linear" / "warmer tones").
_comments.style_signatures: Compact per-style font/hex/radius so Phase-3 recommendations can render in-chat swatches WITHOUT loading any style pack. Mirrors director_engine.STYLE_METADATA (micro_spec); a unit test asserts they match — update both together.
